explanation_full: The Random Forest (RF) model demonstrated solid performance metrics based on the provided scatter plot diagnostics. Specifically, the model achieved an R2 score of 0.7756, indicating a strong proportion of variance explained. The Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) was 0.1254, and the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) was 0.0836. Furthermore, the correlation between predicted and actual values was 0.88511, and the linear fit slope was 0.848822, suggesting a strong positive linear relationship between predictions and actual outcomes.
